steps.prompt: Create an image. Pixel art sprite sheet for a handheld game. The attached image is the existing sprite sheet of this exact character (Reu Linh, a wood element round moss creature, LEGENDARY (final mythic form) stage). Draw NEW animation frames of the SAME character: identical pixel art style, palette, dark outline, proportions, body shape, colours, markings and accessories, and the same size as in the attached sheet, always facing right. Square canvas 1024x1024, flat solid magenta background #FF00FF everywhere (no gradient, no floor, no shadow, no text, no numbers, no grid lines). NO food, NO props, NO human hands. Grid of 4 columns x 4 rows, one character per cell, centered, the whole character fully inside its cell (nothing cropped), sprites must not touch each other, feet on the same line in every cell except the mid-air frames. Row 1: (1) standing idle exactly like the first frame of the attached sheet; (2) EAT: rolling closer and staring at the food; (3) EAT: its mossy body opening wide to swallow it; (4) EAT: squishy chewing, the whole body bulging. Row 2: (5) EAT: moss fluffing up, tiny flowers popping out; (6) PLAY: squashing flat like jelly; (7) PLAY: bouncing up like a rubber ball; (8) PLAY: round and stretched in mid-air. Row 3: (9) PLAY: rolling over the ground; (10) PLAY: squash landing, body flattened; (11) PLAY: tiny flowers blooming on top, cheering; (12) REFUSE food: shrinking into a tight ball. Row 4: (13) PETTED: moss fluffing up, eyes closed; (14) WAVE hello: waving its leaf; (15) SAD: moss drooping, flattened; (16) ANGRY: puffed up with spiky moss.
